subject: Urgent: EmberCore private cluster - hot-shard causing 5xx/error spikes & fallback gaps
messages:
From: Priya Reddy <priya@embercore.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: EmberCore Support <support@embercore.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: urgent - sudden 5xx spike on our VPC (hot-shard?)

Jonas —

We started seeing a sustained increase in 5xx errors from our private deployment around 08:40 PDT today. P95 latency doubled and the error tail is concentrated on a small subset of worker VMs (hot-shard). The customer-facing endpoints are intermittently failing with 503s and some inference requests are timing out after retry.

We've collected logs (attached kprobe excerpt) and a diagnostic snapshot. EmberCore is on a Reserved Dedicated Private plan and this is impacting two paying customers. We need immediate guidance on fallback behavior and whether there's a safe short-term config we can apply to avoid cascading failures while you investigate.

High level: can you confirm (1) whether Redwood runtime is rebalancing KV cache or pinning a hot shard, (2) if autoscale/burst policies are being honored for this VPC, and (3) if there's a recommended rollback to a prior model variant that reduces memory pressure?

Attaching: kprobe_logs.txt, diagnostic_snapshot.tar.gz

Thanks,
Priya Reddy
Head of Platform — EmberCore Analytics
priya@embercore.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@embercore.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: urgent - sudden 5xx spike on our VPC (hot-shard?)

Priya — thanks for the quick heads up and the attachments. Marcus/Irene — looping you both for engineering triage.

Initial notes: from the snapshot it looks like a small subset of model workers are hitting elevated kernel preemptions and KV cache eviction storms — likely a hot-shard effect from a request distribution anomaly. Before we start reverting model variants, two immediate mitigations to consider:

- Activate emergency prefix caching hold to prevent KV invalidation churn for 15 minutes.
- Enforce immediate routing to fallback model-quantized variant (lower memory footprint) for 10% of traffic to test impact.
- Temporarily raise worker autoscale burst limit for this VPC while we stabilize (we can revoke once steady).

Irene/Marcus, please advise on feasibility and safe commands. Priya, we'll need your permission to push the routing override and to temporarily increase burst capacity — this will count as emergency config changes under the Private plan.

I propose an exec sync in 45 minutes if this can't be resolved quickly; Marissa, can you join for the customer escalation call (billing/credits + SLA vector)?

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@embercore.ai>, EmberCore Support <support@embercore.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: urgent - sudden 5xx spike on our VPC (hot-shard?)

We dug into the kprobe snippet. Root cause hypothesis: a small subset of requests are triggering a long decode path that inflates KV cache misses and forces frequent cache compaction on those workers. Compaction is driving CPU steal and p99 latency. Two safe actions we can perform immediately (no model artifact changes):

1) Apply a temporary KV cache soft-hold (config: cache.eviction_threshold -> 0.95) on the affected pool to avoid compaction churn. This is reversible and should stop the thrash.

2) Adjust routing weight to send 15% of traffic to the quantized-8bit variant of the model (compatible for EmberCore workload). This will reduce memory pressure and give us breathing room.

Steps I can run now if you approve: run 'redwood ctl vpc apply-config --vpc embercore-prod --patch kvcache.softhold=0.95' and 'redwood ctl route set-weight --vpc embercore-prod --model my-model-q8 0.15'.

I've attached a short write-up and the smoke-test checklist. If the soft-hold doesn't reduce p99 within 5 minutes, we escalate to adding temporary worker nodes (burst scale) — that needs RedTeam approval (Jonas please ok).

Attachments: embercore_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Backend Engineer, Runtime
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@embercore.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: urgent - sudden 5xx spike on our VPC (hot-shard?)

Priya — I'm joining the live call at 10:30 PDT. From a customer-relations perspective, please confirm impact window and number of affected customers; we'll discuss short-term crediting if this meets severity thresholds.

I support the immediate mitigations Marcus proposed. Jonas, please coordinate the exec sync and include remediation ETA, ask for any required RBAC overrides, and prepare the post-mortem owners. I'd also like a one-page status to share with our CSM and Ops leadership after the call.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@embercore.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: urgent - EmberCore VPC hot-shard resolved — follow-ups and tuning request

Update: summary from today's action run — we applied the kvcache.softhold and routed 15% traffic to the q8 model variant at 09:55 PDT. P95 returned to baseline within ~7 minutes and 5xx rate dropped 92% across the cluster. We also enabled a temporary burst of two worker nodes for 30 minutes while the customer completed in-flight jobs.

Open items and next steps:

- Engineering retrospective: Marcus/Irene to confirm long-term fix (probable guard on request-hotkey distribution + smarter KV partition eviction) and estimate for a targeted patch.
- Config change: propose we persist cache.eviction_threshold -> 0.90 in the stable profile for embercore-prod for 72 hours while we monitor.
- Customer comms: Marissa/Jonas to provide a one-page timeline and proposed SLA credit.
- Security/compliance: Irene to confirm whether any debugging artifacts from the diagnostic snapshot need redaction before retention.

Priya — thanks for the rapid evidence and letting us run the mitigations. I've uploaded the playbook and logs to the shared drive and attached the mutual action plan for signature.

Links: https://redwood.console.local/incidents/INC-4892, https://drive.redwood.com/embercore/kprobe-logs

Jonas Weber
